title: A separable polynomial splits into distinct linear factors over an algebraically closed field
statement: Let $F$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $P\in F[T]$ be monic and separable [def-pc-separable-polynomial] of degree $n$, and let $\Omega$ be an algebraically closed field containing $F$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure]. Viewing $P$ in $\Omega[T]$, there are exactly $n$ pairwise distinct elements $\rho$ of $\Omega$ with $P(\rho)=0$, and $P=\prod_{P(\rho)=0}(T-\rho)$ in $\Omega[T]$.
